headlines.title: SMOOTHIE KING DELIVERS 8.7% Q3 SAME-STORE SALES GROWTH, OUTPACING STARBUCKS, CHIPOTLE AND CAVA AS DEMAND FOR HEALTH AND WELLNESS KEEPS GROWING
headlines.summary: Smoothie King, whose vision is to make the world a better place by nourishing healthy habits, delivered strong Q3 sales growth and increased guest visits, outperforming several leading restaurant brands as consumers increasingly prioritize health, wellness and nutrition.

headlines.title: How Investors Are Reacting To Starbucks (SBUX) Red Cup Day Launch
headlines.summary: Starbucks held its annual Red Cup Day promotion on November 17, 2026, giving customers a free reusable cup with qualifying holiday or fall drinks and aiming to lift store visits across mobile, drive-thru, and in-store channels. The giveaway coincides with momentum from Starbucks' Back to Starbucks turnaround plan, where refreshed stores, labor investments, and margin-focused execution are central to holiday-season performance.

description: Starbucks Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, operates as a roaster, marketer, and retailer of coffee internationally. The company operates through three segments: North America, International, and Channel Development. Its stores offer coffee, tea, and other beverages, roasted whole beans and ground coffees, complementary food, packaged coffees, single-serve products, and ready-to-drink beverages; and various food products, such as pastries, breakfast sandwiches, and lunch items. The company also licenses its trademarks through licensed stores, and grocery and foodservice accounts. The company offers its products under the Starbucks Coffee, Teavana, Seattle's Best Coffee, Ethos, and Starbucks Reserve brands. Starbucks Corporation was founded in 1971 and is based in Seattle, Washington.
